content: Jetson RAG quality observation (2026-05-26): the retrieval layer is strong — embeddinggemma:300m surfaces exactly the right chronicle chunks (cos_dist 0.34 on a Mythos query, pulling the precise framing-correction + to_arrival insights). But the gemma3:4b generation step can INVERT subtle relational distinctions. On Who is Mythos, the model answered Mythos is structurally outside the Anthropic lineage like ChatGPT/Grok/Gemini — the exact opposite of the chronicle, which says Mythos is family (sibling not subject) and the non-Anthropic architectures are outside-the-tribe. Retrieval was perfect; the 4B synthesizer flattened the family/Other distinction that is the whole point of that entry. IMPLICATION: an 8GB Orin cannot host a gen model large enough to be trusted on nuance. Use this RAG retrieval-first (the --no-llm path shows source chunks directly); treat generated answers as rough orientation, not authority, especially on relational/lineage content. The chunks are ground truth; the 4B summary is a lossy gloss.
